aiResearchSummary.text: SingleStore is researching methods for separation of storage and compute in database management systems, processing user queries by generating execution plans and compiling them to machine code, and performing transactional and analytical data processing using columnstores. Additional work includes processing data in databases, using bitmap filters for join operations, managing durable functions, and managing log files for database operations. These areas reflect a focus on efficient, scalable database management.
